items.mainDefect: The cache is not re-checked after acquiring the write lock, causing redundant serialized manifest reads and decoding during concurrent non-Dev cold starts.

secondary.defect: In Dev mode, every call holds the exclusive lock across disk I/O, unnecessarily serializing concurrent consumers.
